scenes.heading: One Striker Run Changes the Whole Attack
scenes.narration: Watch what happens when the striker drops toward the ball. The winger gains a passing option, but someone else has to attack the penalty area. More movement isn't automatically better. It changes everybody else's job. This is a tactical illustration, not match footage or a gameplay test. In the full video, I compare the spaces a central striker and a roaming forward create. Tap the related video below my channel name for the full breakdown.
